build.buildCommand: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; else pip install -r backend/requirements.txt; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ -f main.py ]; then uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}; else cd backend && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}; fi
